description: Expander settings (Opta 4.5+): failsafe {addr, mode 0 hold / 1 all off / 2 preset / 3 standalone, timeout_s 1..250, master, rules_linked, relink_truth, autosync, thermo_stale, stale_period_s} (saved; sync=true pushes the rules to the panel now), capture_preset (addr: the current outputs become the failsafe preset), aux {addr, pin 0=AUX2 1=AUX3, mode 0 0-10V / 1 LED strip}, onewire_rescan=true, onewire_forget (eeprom id of an OFFLINE sensor), forget_panel (addr of an OFFLINE panel). Editor/admin level.
name: myio_expander_set
title: Configure expanders
